name: 贾伊·孙达尔
introduction: Jai Soundar is a talented actor born and based in Atlanta, Georgia and discovered by Director James Gunn when he was cast in Superman 2025. He then quickly landed a lead role in Tiny Fugitives, produced by Seth Rogen & Point Grey Pictures. He is known for his versatility, ability to immerse himself fully in any role, and strong work ethic. While he can portray a wide range of characters and appearances, he is particularly dedicated to increasing diversity and Indian American representation in TV and film. When not acting, he enjoys singing, learning new math algorithms, playing the guitar, reading comics, and spending time with his loved ones.
